title: Fix all text rendering to human-readable format across the entire site

requirements.text: Audit the centralized translations file (frontend/src/translations/translations.ts) for all three language codes (en, hi, mr) and ensure every translation value is a plain, human-readable string. Replace any raw JSON objects, escaped characters, template literal artifacts, untranslated key strings, or stringified arrays with proper readable prose or formatted text. No translation value should ever render as a technical string on screen.

quotes: All the text should be in human readable format

acceptanceCriteria: Every value in the translations object for 'en', 'hi', and 'mr' is a plain string of readable text.
No translation value contains raw JSON, escaped characters (e.g., \n, \"), template literal syntax, or untranslated key names.
Switching between English, Hindi, and Marathi in the language selector renders correct readable text in all three modes.

requirements.text: Audit every component that consumes the language context (NavBar, HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, QualityComplianceSection, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, Footer, ExportCertificationPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, TermsAndConditionsPage) and fix any location where a raw translation key, escaped character sequence, JSON fragment, or template literal artifact is being rendered as visible text instead of the resolved translation string. Each component must call the t() helper correctly and interpolate values where needed.

quotes: All the text should be in human readable format

acceptanceCriteria: No component renders a raw translation key (e.g., 'hero.headline' or 'nav.contact') as visible on-screen text.
No component renders escaped characters or JSON fragments as visible text.
All headings, body paragraphs, labels, button text, list items, and alt text display as clean, readable prose in all three language modes.
The ExportCertificationPage product spec cards display all field names, values, packaging options, and documentation items as properly styled, readable text.
The PrivacyPolicyPage and TermsAndConditionsPage display all section headings, paragraphs, and list items as readable prose.
The NavBar desktop and mobile menu display all nav link labels as readable text in English, Hindi, and Marathi.
The QualityComplianceSection, HeroSection, AboutSection, ProductsSection, ExportCargoSection, SocialMediaSection, ContactSection, and Footer all display fully readable text in all language modes.

requirements.text: Add complete Hindi (hi) and Marathi (mr) translations for any key that currently has a missing, empty, or placeholder value in those language codes within frontend/src/translations/translations.ts. Every key present in the English (en) object must have a corresponding non-empty, human-readable value in both hi and mr, so that switching to Hindi or Marathi never causes a raw key fallback to be displayed.

quotes: All the text should be in human readable format

acceptanceCriteria: Every translation key defined under 'en' also has a non-empty value under 'hi' and 'mr'.
Switching the language selector to Hindi or Marathi never causes any visible raw key string on any page or component.
The LanguageContext t() fallback to English is a safety net only and is not needed for any currently defined key.

constraints: Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not change any visual design, layout, routing, or feature logic — only fix text rendering issues.
The company name 'True Origin Company LLP' must remain untranslated in all language modes.
Contact detail values (phone number, email addresses, website URL) must remain unchanged across all languages — only their labels may be translated.
nonGoals: Adding new sections, pages, or features.
Changing the color palette, typography, or layout.
Adding new languages beyond English, Hindi, and Marathi.
